name: people-v1
about: T-170 #101 / T-183 scenes t and d (crops, one run gives both): the 'People still need people' title and, below it in the same section, the user avatar carousel. The title's 'o' animates 1.3 s after the heading is 35 % visible (IntersectionObserver, JS 6225-6268) and resets when it leaves, so the title is brought in with one quick stroke that ends at rest (minjerk, finger held, no momentum) and plays its animation in place: load, 2 s at rest, a 60 px nudge (title still off screen), 1.5 s, mark title, 480 px in 700 ms (page y ~510, title in the upper middle), 4.5 s at rest; mark carousel: drags of 520, 520 and 200 px (2000, 2000, 1000 ms; plateau ~280 px/s) bring the avatar carousel (it changes every ~1.03 s, Simulator watch) to the middle (y ~1700), 6 s at rest; mark end. Speeds fixed here before any capture; same input on both arms.
